# Sneat Free vendored assets

Source: https://github.com/themeselection/sneat-bootstrap-html-admin-template-free
Version: 3.0.0, commit de094c2bf89e602054b7c14f46c9a3a5b9f6cac9.
Retrieved: 2026-10-28.

`core.css` is the unmodified compiled Sneat theme, including Bootstrap 5.3.3. Template JavaScript, analytics, promotional links and demo application code are not shipped. ExamRoom uses the actual theme components (`btn`, `form-control`, `form-select`, `card`, `menu-item`, `menu-link`) with its existing application logic. All application layout customizations live in `/assets/examroom.css`.

Licenses are included alongside the assets: ThemeSelection MIT (`LICENSE`), Bootstrap MIT (`Bootstrap-LICENSE`), Public Sans SIL Open Font License (`PublicSans-OFL.txt`). The local variable font comes from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/publicsans. No CDN is required for this theme.
